grade.message: On Monday I called to move my Crescent ticket (AMD05A) so it starts in Gainesville instead of Atlanta. The rep put it on the wrong night, 12:24 am on the 27th instead of the 28th. At the station my booking had vanished, then it showed as refunded, and the train left without me. A second person admitted the first rep's mistake. I paid 129 dollars for a hotel and about 55 dollars more for two Ubers, about 185 dollars in all. I don't want a travel credit, I want those costs covered. marcus.bell@example.com, card 6105.
